_comment: THE TWO HANDLERS. The far side of Act 0's door.
Both are gated on `act1:open`, which act0-review unlocks, and each one's work
is gated on `needFaction` -- so the handler you did not join will talk to you
and will not give you anything. That is the design rather than a gap: a
recruiter who pretends you were never on the other side is a worse joke than
Marita and DeFAULT: the capitalisation is the owner's and is checked by the
parser. A pack that spells either of them any other way is refused whole.
The DeFAULT handler carries a bribe -- `needCash` gates the button, `cost`
is what the server actually takes through the wallet door. The gate must be
at least the price or the click is refused after the fact, and the validator

nodes.line: You're the one from the Centrelink. We can get you work by Thursday. It's not good work. It's Thursday.
Agents. There's a bloke doing an auction on somebody's lawn in Newtown and he hasn't asked whose lawn. Go and have a conversation with four of them.
Yeah, I can tell. Go on then.
Marita will get you a job. We looked into the job. The job is the problem.
Sixty dollars. Any way you like. We're not the ones who'll ask.
That's very generous of you and it has bought you exactly nothing. I did say the job was the problem.
Thursday's job, is it. How'd Thursday go.
